title: Laboratory and Clinical Data in Antiphospholipid Patients
official: Constitution d'Une Collection d'Echantillons Biologiques Associee a Une Base de Donnees de Patients Possedant Des Anticorps Antiphospholipides
summary: To constitute a registry of antiphospholipid antibodies positive-patients
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age between 18 and 60 years;
* persistent (at least 12 weeks apart) aPL-positivity within 12 months prior to screening

Exclusion Criteria:

* no inform consent
* impossible follow up
* pregnancy
